page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page, p. 63) in one text block. Running head at top centre. Numbered verses 23 to 28 in italic, then a centred title over three lines, then five hexameter lines with small numbers above words, a centred heading, and a closing line of text with a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes on this page. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

l.i: 23 En cathedram Mosis. repetitum. væ tibi Scriba.
Efficienda alii, quæ fugis, ipse doces.
24 Forma cadit templi, seductio. bella. tenebræ.
Ficus. prima ratis. fur. famulusque vigil.
26 Infusum unguentum. fit pascha. rogat. Cadit auris.
27 Luctus. fur. sors. nox. probra. signa. stuporque Tribunus.
28 Mira vident Mariæ, quas ut confessit Iesus

main_text.head: VERSUS HEXAMETRI, QUIBUS SINGULIS QUINA CAPITA quàm brevissimè comprehen-duntur.
Declaratio vocum ex singulis capitibus memoralium.
main_text.p: Ortus Christi ex semine Dauidis & Abrahami.

page.notes: The printed numbers 1 to 28 above the hexameter words are reference numbers placed over each word; I have marked them as braces before the words. The printed spelling "Lectli" in line 2 is doubtful. The word "Hosiāna" and the tilde over "Numismnaq" and "Signaq" are read from a small scan and may not be exact. The catchword at the lower right is partly cut off and reads "Ada" with the last letter uncertain. Line 1 of the closing text is partly marked with a bracket and underline, which I have not reproduced.
